command:
set -u
ERR=/var/jb/var/mobile/WindowServer.err
launchctl remove UIKitApplication:com.macwsguide.windowserver 2>/dev/null
STARTLINE=$(wc -l < "$ERR" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
setsid /var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/launchdchrootexec 0 0 /var/mnt/rootfs \
  /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/SkyLight.framework/Resources/WindowServer \
  -virtualonly -daemon >> "$ERR" 2>&1 &
echo "SPAWN_BG=$!"
sleep 8
WSPID=$(pgrep -f "Resources/WindowServer" | head -1)
echo "WSPID=$WSPID"
echo "=== new log lines ==="
tail -n +$((STARTLINE+1)) "$ERR" | grep -E "CGXSYNTH|LOADER-OBS|CTOR-CANARY" | head -20
limit: A timeout kills the local SSH process group; remote work may need explicit cleanup.
